rules.source: QNC_v5/.cursor/rules/qnc-story-segment-timeline.mdc (the rule wins over the v5 code)
rules.story_parts: TON/OFF segments (kind tonovi | offovi) in sort_index order; the program is their sum; delete sets active = 0; a1_source_channel is the source channel heard on A1 (zero based, 0 = channel 1 as in v5), chosen on the Wrap segment
rules.development_records: a story without a1_source_channel or covers without a2_source_channel are removed on open, not converted (AGENTS 3)
rules.story_markers: one locked program_start at frame 0 and one locked program_end at the program length; segment borders are no markers; the user places an M marker on a Wrap segment (origin_part_id + origin_local_frame, v5 create_marker_from_part_frame) and the program frame follows; the program timeline only shows markers
rules.story_marker_slots: recomputed after every story change, one slot between every two adjacent markers; slot_id = start_marker_id|end_marker_id
rules.story_covers: a cover is bound to slot_id; deleting a marker (by the user or with its segment) deletes its slots and their covers; any other change keeps the cover on the same marker pair with the new frames, else on the slot keeping its start marker (a new marker split it: trimmed); a2_source_channel is the source channel heard on A2 (zero based, 0 = channel 1)
rules.cover_create: v5 create_cover from source frames: one write makes a virtual shot of class b_roll (the B-roll tab, never a short) for the source IN/OUT and the cover of the slot with the slot frames; a cover already in the slot is replaced; the source is not cut to the slot; the source rate must be the story rate; A2 starts on channel 1; the new cover is selected. delete_cover keeps its B-roll shot and clears the selection when it was selected
rules.segment_exclude: user rule 2026-09-25: one order (sort_index) over active and excluded segments; DeleteSegment excludes (v5 delete_part: active = 0, markers inside go, later ones move left) and the segment keeps its place; IncludeSegment puts it back there (later markers move right by its length); PurgeSegment removes only an excluded segment; MoveSegment swaps with the neighbouring active segment
rules.segment_replace: user rule 2026-09-25: ReplaceSegment gives an active segment the marked source (clip, IN/OUT, same story fps) as its base layer and length; its kind stays; same length: nothing moves; longer: user markers after it move right, covers stay as they are (the added part is uncovered); shorter: user markers in the cut part go with their slots and covers, the ones after it move left; A1 channel back to channel 1
